_readme: Festival-greeting calendar — drives the ADDITIONAL wish post on major festival days
(founder 2026-08-02: 'a nice happy Independence Day with tricolour ... additional post
on all the major festival days which wishes the followers').
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the festivals DB table stores dates as freeform text
('October/November (lunar calendar)') which cannot be parsed into 'today IS Diwali'.
Greeting days therefore come from this curated calendar of majors only.
- 'dates' = exact per-year dates for lunar festivals. VERIFIED ONLY — a wrong-day
greeting is worse than none. All 2026 dates + Holi/Sankranti 2027 verified
- When the last lunar date passes, that festival simply stops firing (fail-silent,
never fail-wrong). REFRESH EACH DECEMBER for the coming year.
- Eid is deliberately ABSENT: it depends on moon sighting and can shift by a day;
add it only with a near-date confirmation step.
- 'where' lines are verified rows from the festivals DB table — do not invent.
- subs are wish-language only (no factual claims that would need verification).
